skill.name: Punctuating speech: marks, commas, new speaker new line
skill.why: Speech marks show readers exactly who said what, and when.
skill.how: Put marks around the spoken words. Punctuation goes inside. New speaker, new line.

beats.say: Speech marks hug the exact words someone says.
The comma, question mark or ! goes inside the marks.
Speaker first? Put a comma before the marks open.
Spoken words start with a capital letter.
New person speaking? Start a new line, like a new speech bubble.
